ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: This story would investigate the flow of money in the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme and identify any potential weaknesses in the system that allowed the fraud to occur.
questions: How did the perpetrators of the scheme launder the money?
What steps can be taken to prevent similar schemes in the future?
ideas.insight: This story could provide valuable insights into the methods used by the perpetrators of the scheme and could help to identify potential solutions to prevent similar schemes in the future.
